issue_description.description: The final read-only audit traced supplement data from typed records through selection, server rendering, progressive enhancement, popover state, heading fragments, share payloads, stable article-ending composition, and document metadata. It inspected the focused browser regressions for pointer, keyboard, touch, filter transition, Clipboard API success, retained copy fallback, total copy failure, server-rendered evidence state, metadata, and JavaScript-disabled content. A focused Playwright run completed with 64 passing tests and 8 expected project-specific skips. The parent task reported that all six required repository gates pass. No failure or source-level defect could be reproduced within the assigned scope.

Result: 64 passed, 8 skipped, 0 failed ```
